Class Highlight

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.highlight.Highlight
public final class Highlight extends Object
A moment of play kept for good: what one court's camera had recorded when someone pressed the button, frozen into a clip.

Immutable. It records no person, because the button carries no identity, so there is no author to fill in later. Giving it a name does not change it either: named(String) returns a new highlight.

  • Constructor Details

    • Highlight

      public Highlight(String id, Instant capturedAt, int courtNumber, String cameraId, VideoClip clip)
      Records a capture that nobody has named yet.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier that tells this highlight apart from every other
      capturedAt - the instant the button was pressed
      courtNumber - the court the capture came from, starting at 1
      cameraId - the camera whose recording became the clip
      clip - the saved clip file
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any argument is missing or blank, or the court number is not positive
